list.text: I saw some suspect people on this cavern.
The cave can be dangerous sometimes.
I came because I heard there're some very rare fossils here.
If you cross this entire cave you'll arrive in Cerulean City.
I'm digging fossils here on the Mt. Moon.
Every now and then, Brock from Pewter comes to give me a hand.
How do I get out of here?\nIt's so big, I might get lost.

Whoa!
You scared me!
...
...Oh, it's just a kid!
Kids should not be walking around here...\nIt can be dangerous.
\f[faceyellow]\rIt seems that Pika can feel Red's presence here!
\f[faceyellow]\rWe'll go to look for him!\nPlease follow us!
